plainText:
The Last Battle IX (Japanese: 最終決戦IX The Last Battle IX) is the 175th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 85th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
On the three carriages of the Magnet Train that are accelerating towards a dead end, Chuck, Jasmine, Janine, and Sabrina, along with Clair after she had battled , continue to fend off s. , along with Erika and Brock, are in the driver's cab. They panic as they can do nothing about the out-of-control train.

Suddenly, someone appears on the tracks, sending out his . Snorlax pushes against the train with all its might, sending it to an abrupt stop right at the dead end. The Gym Leaders look outside to see , equipped with all three of the fully evolved Kanto first partner Pokémon. Blue jumps off the train to join his former rival, who is fully healed. Red explains to Erika that he followed the direction in which he was led by the spoon left to him by Sabrina. Erika tries to find Misty, only to realize she had been on the other half of the train which went back to the Indigo Plateau. 

Blue suggests heading back there immediately. Chuck, peeking out from one of the train doors, tells Blue that he and the other Gym Leaders will also be at the Indigo Plateau once all remaining enemies in the train are eliminated. With that, he wishes Blue luck. Blue sends out his newly-trained to burrow underground to reach their destination, because the enemy may still have laid traps above ground. Before they do so, Erika lends Red her Pokégear after finding out that Red doesn't have one.

Rhydon starts spinning his drill to burrow underground. Just as he starts to burrow across, the spoon that Red is holding changes direction. Blue decides to follow the spoon's direction. As Rhydon continues to drill through, Red and Blue find that they are heading to the Ilex Forest. They notice a presence behind them.
